verdict: Included portal references and named arrivals pass export validation. Runtime access, complete transport coverage, and exact geographic placement remain unverified.

exampleRoute.method: Directed unweighted BFS using all type1/2/3 inter-map pairs

corrections.issue: Return-town affiliation was used as physical containment.
corrections.status: Fixed. Only a spot primary map receives that published artwork anchor. homeId is return-town metadata; no inherited coordinates.

corrections.issue: A type-2-only filter omitted valid exported portal variants.
corrections.status: Expanded from 357 to 457 directed inter-map pairs using types 1, 2 and 3, preserving multiple source portal alternatives.

coordinates.publishedAnchors: Third-party published atlas artwork anchors, not independently verified official client world-map coordinates.
coordinates.unplacedMaps: Retained as searchable and routable records; do not imply a geographic location.
coordinates.schematicCorridors: Three additional forest positions are explicitly authored schematic positions, not published atlas anchors. Full intermediate map sequences remain available.
coordinates.localPortalCoordinates: Local game-map coordinates are separate from world artwork coordinates.

corridors.caveat: Published atlas anchors are third-party. Three newly drawn interior anchors are explicitly schematic. Portal presence and matched arrival names do not verify runtime conditions, transport costs, or access gates.

geometryValidationLimits: Sampled curve-intersection checks establish properties of authored artwork only; they do not establish exact in-game paths or runtime reachability.

exclusions.note: Outside-fixture maps, special scripts and other portal types require separate research. A client record does not guarantee current public availability.

caveats: Export-validated connection graph, not runtime-playtested navigation. Named arrivals exist for every included portal record.
Exact costs, timings, quest gates, class/level restrictions and activation conditions are not established by these portal records. Use unknown, not zero, for costs/timing.

Types1 and3 were previously hidden only because the preview filtered for type2. They are valid exported numeric portal variants with verified destination records; visual/activation semantics have not been independently verified here.
Top-level name/arrival/type choose a deterministic representative (prefer2, then1, then3). alternatives preserves EVERY source portal; exact intra-map choice needs local position and restrictions.
Intra-map teleports are retained separately and should not count as world-map transitions.
Outside-fixture destinations and types other than1/2/3 are explicit exclusions; this is not a claim of complete game transport coverage.
No homeId or return-town coordinate inheritance is used.
artAndDataRights: Game data and character artwork belong to their respective owners, including Nexon. Public availability does not establish a redistribution license or supported API contract.
